description: Second, sealed test (test2; 40 chapters, fixed before any system runs on them): chapters 996-1350 of snapshot to1350-4c4b1c91075e (chapters 991-995 left out: the frozen S3 seeds already ran on them for the pre-annotation demo), stratified by six chapter-number ranges of about 59 chapters each (the novel project's plot units stop at chapter 990), the same systematic sampling as the first test (novel_ner.sample_test). Take the first n = 40 of test2_996_1350.order.json, annotate in 8 packages of 5 (GPT-6.1-Sol two passes, the annotator's name questions, Astra on the rest; guide v1.1 and instructions v1 frozen), then seal: configs/test2_seal.json; while sealed, tagger predict, claude_run and codex_run refuse these chapters. It is opened once, in stage 3, after the final method is frozen and committed, and scored once. Training, dictionary and every weak source stay at chapters <= 780 (snapshot to0990); text of these chapters is read only from to1350 at that one evaluation.
n_note: fixed on 2026-10-04 before any chapter of this range was annotated or any system ran on it (chapters 991-995, which S3 ran on for the demo, are outside the range)
strata_source: six equal-count chapter-number ranges over the 355 chapters 996-1350 of the snapshot (plot units exist only up to 990)
